comment: ONNX models fetched by scripts/fetch_models.py into $SPG_CACHE_DIR/models/<name>/<version>/<file>. Every file is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; a mismatch aborts the fetch and nothing is installed. Weights never enter Git. 'warmup_inputs' gives a concrete shape per model input (in model input order) for session warmup; 'metadata' lists custom metadata keys consumers rely on.

yunet.source: OpenCV Zoo YuNet (Shiqi Yu), Hugging Face mirror opencv/face_detection_yunet

ppocr-det-en.source: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv3 English mobile detector, ONNX conversion by RapidOCR v3.9.2 (hash matches its default_models.yaml)

ppocr-rec-en.source: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 English mobile recognizer, ONNX conversion by RapidOCR v3.9.2 (hash matches its default_models.yaml); character dictionary embedded in metadata key 'character'

datasets_comment: Evaluation datasets, fetched only for local runs by eval/spg_eval/fetch.py into $SPG_CACHE_DIR/deps/dataset-<name>/<version>-any/ after the SHA-256 check. They hold images of real people: never committed, redistributed, or uploaded as a CI artifact. scripts/fetch_models.py ignores this section.

lfw.purpose: Faces eval suite (SPG-03): face crops composited onto generated backgrounds
lfw.license: No license granted; the LFW authors provide it for research use. Local evaluation only, never redistributed
lfw.source: Labeled Faces in the Wild (Huang et al., UMass Amherst), lfw.tgz on the figshare mirror that scikit-learn's fetch_lfw_people uses (same SHA-256)
